name: spacemail-by-nwd
description: Check, search, read and draft replies to your Spacemail (Spaceship) business emails, across several mailboxes. Replies are saved as drafts unless you turn sending on.

mailbox_1_password.title: Password
mailbox_1_password.description: The mailbox password (not your Spaceship account password). Stored in your system's secure credential store.

mailbox_1_label.title: Nickname (optional)
mailbox_1_label.description: A short name for this mailbox, e.g. Support. Leave blank to use the domain name.

mailbox_2_email.title: Second mailbox: email address (optional)
mailbox_2_email.description: Another Spacemail address to connect. Leave blank if you only have one.

mailbox_2_password.title: Second mailbox: password (optional)
mailbox_2_password.description: The password for the second mailbox.

mailbox_2_label.title: Second mailbox: nickname (optional)
mailbox_2_label.description: A short name for the second mailbox, e.g. Sales.

allow_send.title: Allow Claude to send emails
allow_send.description: Off by default: Claude saves replies as drafts for you to check and send. Turn on to let Claude send when you ask it to.
